planned_outcome: Add physics-based core-sensor classifier that overrides firmware VirtualCoreSensor when a combined heat-slowness + cool-slowness score indicates a different sensor is the true core. Mirror the existing surface-sensor correction pattern.
actual_outcome: Physics-based core-sensor classifier shipped. Combined heat-rank + cool-rank score overrides firmware VirtualCoreSensor when confidence gap >= 4. Wonder white lidded bake now resolves core to T5 (was T1). All 3 unlidded real CSVs hold firmware pick. Downstream propagation fixed: sensor_naming now drives off loader.get_core_sensor().
success_metric_result: 21 dedicated tests green (6 new: 3 flipped red->green, 3 guardrails); full suite 126/8/1, +6 passing vs previous baseline 120/8/1; no new regressions

adopt: Red-cell reproduces prior captain's Monte-Carlo rather than trusting self-reports (3 missions proven)
Downstream propagation trace as red-cell item (catches integration gaps unit tests miss)
Rewrite over patch for DRY fixes when a patch would add a second code path
Accept ties in fixture annotations when physics is ambiguous within tolerance (e.g. expected_core in {T5, T6})
